accessibility.title: Centered mobile navigation menu behavior
accessibility.description: When a reader opens the mobile navigation menu, a dimmed backdrop appears and the menu panel is centered in the viewport. Its labels are centered independently of their arrows, and reduced-motion preferences disable the new animations.

review_notes: Automated merge documentation; human review is not claimed.
The record is limited to the supplied merged-change evidence.
Simple and Technical pages describe the same safety boundaries.
PR #540 documents a centered mobile navigation panel, backdrop, animations, and reduced-motion behavior.
